description: Intent i009 (SNAPSHOT=s02, branch ioctl-sock-usercopy-string) complete. Two high-confidence findings, both exact structural twins of the seed mechanism, unfixed in s02: drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c line 315 (bnad_debugfs_write_regrd) and line 375 (bnad_debugfs_write_regwr) each do kern_buf = memdup_user(buf, nbytes) — an exactly nbytes-sized heap allocation copying attacker-controlled bytes with no NUL terminator — then immediately call sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", ...) (lines 319 and 379), a C-string parser that scans past the allocation end when the user supplies nbytes non-NUL bytes (slab OOB read, KASAN). Both are registered via bnad_debugfs_op_regrd/bnad_debugfs_op_regwr file_operations (lines 449-463) on debugfs files "regrd" (0644) and "regwr" (0200) under /sys/kernel/debug/bna/pci_dev:*/. No len+1, strndup_user, memdup_user_nul, or memchr termination check exists in either function (fully read lines 300-400). Fix primitive is memdup_user_nul. The ioctl/sockopt/netlink-focused audit found no additional variant: btrfs ioctl vol_args strcmp sites are guarded by memchr NUL validation helpers (fs/btrfs/ioctl.c:230-242) before every use; netlink string consumers (ipvs, devlink param, nfnetlink cttimeout, tipc netlink_compat, ethtool header/bitset) are all covered by NLA_NUL_STRING policies or bounded strnlen; rbd sysfs, amdgpu_ras (memset-then-copy into 65-byte str), ucma set_option, sed-opal ioctl, sctp connectx, f_fs, and vhost-vdpa were all verified safe with concrete evidence (13 candidates classified: 11 safe, 2 reported). Limitations: copy_from_user appears in ~1112 files; only ioctl/sockopt/netlink/char-dev contexts co-located with string helpers were reviewed; compat_ioctl, io_uring register, and most media/DVB ioctls were pattern-scanned only; no compilation/dynamic testing (read-only snapshot).
